<a id="fn---constructor"></a>
### `__constructor`

```rust
fn __constructor(admin: Address, agent: Address, collateral: Address, market_core: Address, max_trade: i128, max_market: i128, max_daily: i128, max_net_exposure: i128, config_delay: u64, max_drawdown: i128, window_days: u32, creation_policy: CreationPolicy)
```

- **Caller / Auth:** deployer (constructor)
- **Spec Doc:** Registers `agent` as the first agent with every role and the global caps as its own. `max_net_exposure` caps capital deployed in open positions across all markets at once (see `net_exposure`); it must be at least `max_trade`. `config_delay` (seconds, at least `MIN_CONFIG_DELAY`) is the timelock on every loosening change. Any collateral the treasury already holds is minted as shares to `admin`.

<a id="fn-execute-config"></a>
### `execute_config`

```rust
fn execute_config() -> Result<(), Error>
```

- **Caller / Auth:** anyone (permissionless after config_delay)
- **Spec Doc:** Applies the pending config once its delay has passed. Permissionless, so execution never depends on the admin being available. A `market_core` change records the old core as legacy: its positions stay where they are (recover them with `legacy_redeem` / `legacy_claim_pool_remainder`), and exposure for the new core is kept under keys namespaced by core so market ids cannot collide. The new core must be pointed at this treasury with its own `set_treasury`.

<a id="fn-migrate-market"></a>
### `migrate_market`

```rust
fn migrate_market(market_id: u64) -> Result<(), Error>
```

- **Caller / Auth:** admin (require_auth)
- **Spec Doc:** Moves the treasury's position in `market_id` — and the LP role, when the treasury is the market's creator and has not claimed the remainder yet — to the successor set via `set_successor`, then closes the local exposure. Admin-only: relocating capital is not an agent trading action, and the agent key must not be able to drain positions. market-core's `transfer_position` / `transfer_lp` require the treasury itself to authorize. Because the treasury is their *direct* caller here, the implicit invoker authorization covers both — no `authorize_as_current_contract` entry is needed (unlike the nested token transfer in `agent_buy`, see `docs/adr/0002-treasury-nested-auth.md`).

<a id="fn-nav"></a>
### `nav`

```rust
fn nav() -> Result<i128, Error>
```

- **Caller / Auth:** anyone (read-only)
- **Spec Doc:** Net asset value: idle collateral plus, for every market in the open- market index, what the holdings are worth whatever the outcome (complete sets and the LP's `min` reserve while open, the exact settlement value once final), minus what queued withdrawals are owed. Directional exposure is valued at zero, so no trade against a pool can raise NAV.

### `PricePolicy`

Price limits on every agent trade, in bps of the outcome's spot price.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `max_buy_price_bps` | `u32` | Never buy an outcome priced above this. |
| `max_impact_bps` | `u32` | Largest `\|p_after - p_before\|` a single trade may cause. |
| `max_slippage_bps` | `u32` | Tolerance applied to the same-transaction quote to derive the effective `min_shares_out` / `max_shares_in`. |
| `min_sell_price_bps` | `u32` | Never sell an outcome priced below this. |

### `SignerConfig`

> Imported from [`resolver`](./resolver.md#signerconfig) via `contractimport!`.

### `UsageWindow`

Hourly ring buffer behind `max_daily`. Kept in instance storage: ~400 bytes that every call loads anyway, so it costs no extra ledger-entry read (a persistent entry would add one per trade). Per-agent windows have the same shape but live in persistent storage.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amounts` | `Vec<i128>` | Always `BUCKETS` long. `amounts[i]` is the usage of hour `head_hour - ((head_idx - i) mod BUCKETS)`. |
| `head_hour` | `u64` | Hour index (`timestamp / BUCKET_SECONDS`) of the newest bucket. |
| `head_idx` | `u32` | — |

### `Valuation`

`market_valuation` result. Only `cost_basis` is enforced (by `max_net_exposure`); the others are informational.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `at_risk` | `i128` | `max(0, cost_basis - floor_value)`. |
| `cost_basis` | `i128` | — |
| `floor_value` | `i128` | What the treasury gets back whatever the outcome, from state a price move cannot raise: complete sets `min(yes, no)` plus, as the unclaimed LP, `min(reserve_yes, reserve_no)`. After finality, the settlement value. |
| `spot_value` | `i128` | Holdings at the pool's spot price. Manipulable by any trader, so it is never used for enforcement. |

> Imported from [`resolver`](./resolver.md#weightedkey) via `contractimport!`.

> Imported from [`resolver`](./resolver.md#weightedkeyconfig) via `contractimport!`.

Collateral still owed to `owner` for shares already burned.

| `owner` | `Address` | — |
| `remaining` | `i128` | — |

## Events

### `AgentPolicyCancelled`

- **Prefix topics:** `"agent_policy_cancelled"`
- **Topic fields:** `agent: Address`
- **Data fields (`map`):** —
- **Indexer filter:** `[Symbol("agent_policy_cancelled"), "*"]`

### `AgentPolicyProposed`
